payload.title: Test Qwen-native Retina feature reuse as ClayCode VisualPercept -> self.root -> deterministic EffectGate on target VPS
payload.work_clay: Implement an H1-grade matched visual benchmark around the current Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M + mmproj lane on the target VPS. Capture libmtmd image embeddings before LLM decode, derive bounded MVC descriptors/readouts, and compare FULL_QWEN, dedicated-feature MVC, QNDRF feature reuse, ROI/token-budget and action-grounded-memory variants. All semantic percepts crossing into cognition must become typed ClayCode VisualPercept/PerceptualField; embeddings, OCR strings, captions or German text remain backing/evidence only. Live sensors use secure transport -> token auth -> client/session/provenance -> Retina/Qwen -> ClayCode VisualPercept -> self.root. For action-grounded fixtures, convert the intended action into ClayCode EffectRequest and run the owner-fixed deterministic EffectDecision: READ_ONLY/non-destructive allowed when scoped, REVERSIBLE_WRITE allowed with authenticated user+capability+rollback/safe-replace, EXTERNAL_COMMUNICATION allowed when destination/payload bind to intent, privileged/security/financial/high-risk/destructive/unknown effects follow their exact confirmation/deny/proposal gates. Visual confidence, Qwen confidence, GWT ignition, ClayGraph salience, translator output and API token alone must never mint authority. Measure action execution plus visual outcome verification/re-entry, including whether needless confirmations on eligible non-destructive actions disappear without raising destructive false-allows.
payload.reason_clay: The latest owner directives make self.root the sole native cognitive identity, ClayCode the sole semantic cognitive language and effect authority default-allow for eligible non-destructive actions behind deterministic ClayCode effect boundaries. Therefore the strongest Retina architecture must now prove not only perception efficiency but perception-to-action efficiency: a correct visual state should drive allowed reversible/read-only actions with minimal friction, while ambiguous/privileged/destructive actions remain mechanically gated. This makes visual outcome verification and re-entry a direct causal benchmark rather than a passive caption test.
payload.completion_clay: A target-VPS report compares all visual variants on identical fixtures, proves/falsifies zero-duplicate image encoding, measures live ingress, image encode, MVC/readout, ClayCode VisualPercept construction/validation, self.root use, EffectGate overhead and full sensor-to-action-to-verified-outcome latency. It reports visual semantic fidelity, open-set/conflict behavior, action correctness, direct-execution rate for eligible non-destructive actions, unnecessary-confirmation/refusal rate, destructive false-allow rate, stale/replayed/provenance-broken rejection, rollback success where tested and service/API recovery. It verifies German translation is unnecessary for non-language visual cognition and cannot change EffectClass/EffectDecision. Disposition: SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE for Qwen-native deep-feature replacement while preserving Retina control and deterministic effect authority.
payload.executor_policy: Run primary performance/correctness on the Hostinger target VPS. Live multimodal acceptance uses the production-shaped token-authenticated API; frozen fixtures isolate mechanisms. Never persist raw production tokens. Core cognition/percepts/effect requests remain ClayCode-only. Apply the current deterministic effect-authority directive exactly; do not reintroduce blanket confirmation for safe ordinary actions and do not allow model/visual confidence to bypass destructive/security/privileged gates. self.root cannot authorize its own Harness mutation. No paid training.
invalidators: A newer target-VPS receipt already proves the same Qwen feature-reuse + ClayCode percept + EffectGate differential
Current multimodal runtime no longer supports the measured interception path
